acceptanceBoundaries: ONE outbound follow-up total for the exact request across QUOTE and REQUEST. A same retained job may reconcile; an unknown POST is not blindly repeated.

QUOTE invitation requires the retained owner-recorded quote-sent milestone for the current request/source. Prior reached contact does not cancel a new plan; new human contact, ordinary customer reply, closure, STOP, source/recipient correction, supersession or cancellation prevent unsent outreach. Callback completion and SMS receipts do not mean paid work completed.

Only a signed exact-purpose/ref initiation followed by the fixed provider-accepted sent disclosure and a later distinct exact-purpose/ref affirmation can establish permission. Acceptance is not a carrier-delivered claim; failed terminal disclosure cannot be revived by a late accepted response. Generic YES, START, saved phone, model prose and owner checkboxes never supply this permission.

Permission must cover the chosen date, not merely be valid today. Late permission requires a new future time. Current program/source, quiet hours, budget and sending authority are checked again before transport.
